column1: # International Code of Signals: one flag per character, read by NauticalFlags at startup.
# Columns, tab-separated: character, codeword, glyph. Unicode has no signal-flag code points, so
# the glyph approximates the flag's colours and layout; the codeword is authoritative, and flags
# that really do look alike (Tango and pennant 3, Kilo and pennant 5) share a glyph.
